_comment: Official riskometer disclosure sources only. AMFI first; AMC disclosures as fallback. URL templates: {Mon}=Jan..Dec, {MM}=01..12, {YY}=26, {YYYY}=2026 for the most recent month-end (the script tries up to 12 prior months; only URLs returning a PDF with HTTP 200 and no redirect are stored, and stored links are re-checked every run). levelColumn = which risk-level column (0-based) in a table row is the scheme's current level. Never add third-party portals.

sources.reason: AMFI's Risk-o-meter page is an interactive web application without a documented downloadable file; its host also refused connections from the build environment. Enable with a verified machine-readable AMFI file URL when one is confirmed.
